| Observation datasets | 3 |

Layered brucite lattice-average empirical volume EOS, including H rearrangement; not a hydrogen-order-resolved thermodynamic fit or a phase-boundary model. Fukui describes a higher-order H change; Sun (2025) XRD supports the layered average lattice beyond this range. Ambient atomic sites are a reference only. Direct ambient average F-free hydrogenated structure from He (2023), Table 4.3. Source structure and EOS samples differ; no rescaling. All 102 Fukui/Xia observations preserved.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Powder X-ray isothermal compression; V0(T) from independent ambient expansion measurements. No acoustic or shock coefficients substituted.
- **Equation:** Equation (2), p. 513: ordinary third-order Birch-Murnaghan.
- **V0:** Table 2: V0(300)=40.917(12) A^3. For high-T slices, p. 513 states V0 was fixed from ambient expansion using Eq. (1) and Table 3 constant alpha=6.69(18)e-5 K^-1. V0(T)=40.917 exp\[6.69e-5(T-300)\]. Static compression V0 treatment is not separately stated; Table 2 anchoring is explicit here and subject to integration review. Derived high-T V0 errors are missing because covariance is unreported, not zero.
- **K0:** Table 5 and duplicated Table 6, p. 515; Kprime error 0.3 in Table 5, 0.4 in Table 6
- **K0 prime:** Table 5 and duplicated Table 6, p. 515; Kprime error 0.3 in Table 5, 0.4 in Table 6
- **Reference temperature (K):** Exact listed isotherm; no interpolation or temperature extrapolation between records.

</details>

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Powder X-ray isothermal compression; V0(T) from independent ambient expansion measurements. No acoustic or shock coefficients substituted.
- **Equation:** Equation (2), p. 513: ordinary third-order Birch-Murnaghan.
- **V0:** Table 2: V0(300)=40.917(12) A^3. For high-T slices, p. 513 states V0 was fixed from ambient expansion using Eq. (1) and Table 3 constant alpha=6.69(18)e-5 K^-1. V0(T)=40.917 exp\[6.69e-5(T-300)\]. Static compression V0 treatment is not separately stated; Table 2 anchoring is explicit here and subject to integration review. Derived high-T V0 errors are missing because covariance is unreported, not zero.
- **K0:** Table 6, p. 515
- **K0 prime:** Table 6, p. 515
- **Reference temperature (K):** Exact listed isotherm; no interpolation or temperature extrapolation between records.

</details>
